_doc: Ground-truth oracle for the Alex Pare (de-identified: 'John Faux') vendor documents. Two DISTINCT sources: (1) the P&S 4.0 ANS Diagnostic Implication Summary PDF (image-only → OCR), which carries identity + anthropometrics + QUALITATIVE per-phase findings and NO numeric LFa/RFa/SB grid; and (2) the Colombo consultation LETTER (text layer), which carries the numeric SB=2.59 and the interpretive/treatment prose. These are transcribed by hand from the signed documents and used as an assertion contract. do_not_load_at_runtime.

baseline.narrative: All parameters within normal ranges (includes borderline conditions)

deepBreathingValsalva.narrative: All ANS responses within normal ranges (includes borderline conditions); Abnormal changes in HR (from baseline to DB)

stand.narrative: High sympathetic response to stand suggesting a possible risk of pre-syncope

colomboLetter._source: Colombo consultation letter (text layer). Interpretive + treatment prose. MUST NOT be turned into automatic therapy recommendations by the engine.
colomboLetter.restFindings: normal HR & BP, low Parasympathetic activity indicating Advanced Autonomic Dysfunction (AAD), normal Sympathetic activity, high-normal Sympathovagal Balance (SB = 2.59), indicating high-morbidity risk
colomboLetter.standing: Sympathetic Excess (SE, beta-adrenergic), (pre-clinical) Syncope risk; Standing BP was not recorded; possible masked Sympathetic Withdrawal (SW)
treatmentProse: Alpha-Lipoic Acid (ALA; 600 mg tid, time release)
low-and-slow exercise, walking at 2 mph up to 40 min/day for 6 months
colomboLetter.note: Letter retest is 3 months; the summary report states 6 months. These two vendor documents legitimately differ and both provenances are preserved.

engineContract._doc: What THIS engine must and must not do with the Pare inputs.

fromAnsAlone.note: Raw .ans yields Ewing ratios + ectopy + identity + waveform only. LFa/RFa/SB/BP stay Not assessed.

withVendorSummaryOcr.note: Vendor summary supplies identity + anthropometrics + qualitative findings; it carries NO numeric spectral grid, so per-phase LFa/RFa/SB remain Not assessed even when the summary is attached.

mustNever: publish waveform-derived LFa/RFa/SB as vendor-reported, PhysioPS-validated, or clinically interpretable values (HumanOS may compute them only as labelled estimates)
calibrate waveform-derived spectral values with a constant fitted to any single patient or PDF
emit ALA / hydration / salt / Nortriptyline / Midodrine as automatic therapy recommendations
treat the Colombo letter's treatment prose as an engine recommendation
show an ATOM connection error as the primary clinical summary
